messages:
kevin: spotting a regression in reranker-prod after the model rollout at 11:07 UTC. relevance drop for a subset of long-context queries and p95 latency up ~22%. small user complaints. need an expedited mitigation.
mika: can you link the dashboard and an example failing query?
kevin: dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/reranker?region=global spike at 11:07. example query id=Q-98231 returned poor ordering for long-passages.
ops_lead: what's the mitigation? pin model or tweak scoring config?
kevin: suggest pin model image reranker:v1.9.4-fallback (previous stable) for global traffic and revert scoring-lambda to 0.85 from 0.95. rollout only on reranker-prod; plan: canary 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual gates. owner = mika.
sre_oncall: I can approve expedited canary if we have rollback one-liner, changelog, and a monitoring plan. abort if user-visible error rate > 0.4% or p95 latency increases > 25% for 5m.
release_manager: please draft release note and tag expedited. also need billing tag and CS notif.
kevin: draft release note:
```
Hotfix (expedited): revert reranker model from v1.10.0-quant to v1.9.4-fallback and lower scoring lambda to 0.85 to address relevance regressions and tail latency increase observed in long-context queries. No config schema changes.
```

deploybot: @mika scheduled deploy id=dr-1765234567-0. Service=reranker env=prod region=global from=v1.10.0-quant to=v1.9.4-fallback owner=mika. Strategy=staged-canary slices=[0.5%,5%,25%,100%]; checks=[health(30s), p95, relevance_score, error-rate]. Manual approval required between stages.
mika: infra thumbs-up, starting 0.5% canary now. logs: dr-1765234567-0 canary-start.
sre_oncall: monitoring: watch p95, service-error-rate, and a small set of golden queries for relevance degradation. abort criteria re-stated: error-rate > 0.4% OR p95 regresses > 25% sustained 5m.
mika: 8m update: p95 -16%, golden-set avg relevance improved 12%, errors unchanged. approve move to 5%.
deploybot: progressing deploy to 5% slice.
ops_lead: posting status page note: "Mitigation deploy in progress for reranker service; no downtime expected." CS notified for impacted customers.
mika: 12m at 5% stable. proceed to 25%.
sre_oncall: observed small noise spike at 3m but returned to baseline; approve 25%.
deploybot: advancing to 25% slice.
mika: 15m at 25% stable; relevance metrics hold. recommend full rollout.
deploybot: progressing to 100% slice.
deploybot: deploy complete id=dr-1765234567-0 -> status=success slices=100%.
release_manager: changelog updated, tagged expedited-hotfix. billing team notified. will file postmortem if RCA warrants.
sre_oncall: rollback command (one-liner):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/reranker --to-revision=deploy-v1.10.0-quant && kubectl rollout status -n prod deploy/reranker
```

kevin: thanks all. follow-ups: add test coverage for long-context ranking, investigate model quantization path that caused the regression, and consider auto-pin rule if golden-set drops > 10% during rollout. closing thread once RCA ticket is linked. :thumbsup:
